method: Read only neutral annotation-inputs.json and rubric.md for these control labels; no author labels/build/finalize-draft/README or model outputs. Prior familiarity with frozen scope appendix and study runner from separately authorized review is explicitly disclosed: this second annotation is not prompt-blind. Author first labels were independently authored without the appendix. Labels are independent of author expected outputs and model results. Each retained passage is assessed separately without borrowing companion facts.
